report:
Duodenum, D2, biopsy

Serial sections show four pieces of duodenal mucosa. No crypt apoptosis is seen. Paneth cells are preserved. The lamina propria contains a sparse inflammatory infiltrate. Eosinophils are inconspicuous. No viral cytopathic change or granuloma is seen. Immunohistochemistry for cytomegalovirus (CMV) is negative. There is no evidence of graft-versus-host disease. There is no evidence of dysplasia or malignancy. Please correlate with clinical findings.

DUODENUM, D2, biopsy:
- NO EVIDENCE OF GRAFT-VERSUS-HOST DISEASE.
